properties.name: audit.enabled
properties.description: Master switch. Set to false to disable the entire audit starter.

properties.name: audit.name
properties.description: Logical name of the service using this starter. Written as service_name on every log entry.

properties.name: audit.security.enabled
properties.description: Enable role-based security on the audit endpoints.

properties.name: audit.security.roles.read
properties.description: Spring Security role required to read audit logs.

properties.name: audit.security.roles.write
properties.description: Spring Security role required to create audit logs.

properties.name: audit.security.roles.admin
properties.description: Spring Security role required for admin operations (delete, GDPR erasure).

properties.name: audit.tenancy.enabled
properties.description: Enable multi-tenancy support.

properties.name: audit.tenancy.strategy
properties.description: Strategy for resolving the current tenant: HEADER, JWT_CLAIM, or SUBDOMAIN.

properties.name: audit.tenancy.header-name
properties.description: HTTP header name used when strategy=HEADER.

properties.name: audit.tenancy.jwt-claim
properties.description: JWT claim name used when strategy=JWT_CLAIM.

properties.name: audit.tenancy.enforce-isolation
properties.description: Reject requests with a missing tenant identifier (HTTP 400) when enabled.

properties.name: audit.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Enable rate limiting on audit write operations.

properties.name: audit.rate-limit.limit
properties.description: Maximum number of write requests allowed per window.

properties.name: audit.rate-limit.window
properties.description: Sliding window duration for rate limiting.

properties.name: audit.rate-limit.distributed
properties.description: Use Redis for distributed rate limiting (requires spring-boot-starter-data-redis).

properties.name: audit.api.base-path
properties.description: Base path for the audit REST API.

properties.name: audit.api.bulk-atomic
properties.description: When true, the batch endpoint is fully atomic (all-or-nothing). When false, partial success returns 207.

properties.name: audit.soft-delete.enabled
properties.description: Use soft delete (sets deleted_at) instead of hard delete.

properties.name: audit.async.enabled
properties.description: Process audit write operations asynchronously in a dedicated thread pool.

properties.name: audit.cache.enabled
properties.description: Enable local Caffeine cache for audit read queries.

values.description: Read tenant from X-Tenant-ID header (or custom header-name).
Extract tenant from a JWT claim.
Derive tenant from the first hostname segment.
